definicion: A ticket is ready for an AI agent if someone outside the team could complete it without asking.

contenido.como: The description has at least 40 words and does not just repeat the title.

criterios.como: There is a section or a recognisable pattern: acceptance criteria, given / when / then, a checklist or sentences starting with must / should.

patrones.patron: criterios? de aceptacion|acceptance criteria|acceptance tests?|definicion de hecho|definition of done
^\s*[-*]?\s*(el sistema |la aplicacion |la app |the system |the application |the app |the user |it )?(no )?(debe|must|should|shall)\b

acotado.como: It is not an epic and its estimate (or its duration, if it has no estimate) does not exceed the limit.

referencias.como: It has at least one link, another ticket key, an attachment or a code or design path.

sinDependencias.como: It is not blocked and does not say it depends on something else or is blocked by something.

patrones.patron: \b(depende de|dependemos de|bloquead[oa] por|a la espera de|pendiente de que|blocked by|blocked until|blocked on|depends on|depends upon|dependent on|waiting for|waiting on|waiting until|on hold until)\b
